WITH circuit_summary AS (
  SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS avg_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races FROM circuit_summary
),
top_counts AS (
  SELECT race_count
  FROM circuit_summary
  ORDER BY race_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT MIN(race_count) AS min_top_count FROM top_counts
)
SELECT cs.circuitId, cs.avg_round, cs.race_count,
       CAST(cs.race_count AS REAL) / total.total_races
FROM circuit_summary AS cs
CROSS JOIN total
CROSS JOIN cutoff
WHERE cs.race_count >= cutoff.min_top_count
ORDER BY CAST(cs.race_count AS REAL) / total.total_races DESC
